rows_drop.name: Nikodemos the Hagiorite
rows_drop.reason: Out of window: a man of 1782 in a 1453-1650 tradition, held on a Pedalion row the Library moves to the 1650-1821 shelf (#1577). He stays in the Kollyvades row.

field_overrides.reason: The validator requires every modern-country place on the place label, and a label names at most two places from region. Italy (minister general) and Paris (master) stay; Lyon, where he died at the council, is carried by 'and beyond'. IDs unchanged from the draft, which copied them from existing entries.
